structure.dock-items: The demo has ten dock tiles including Projects and App Studio. App Studio is out of scope by decision and Projects is a demo-only surface, so Aether ships eight.
token.surface: Aether's window fill is 98% opaque; the demo uses color-mix(surface-solid 92%, transparent). The remaining difference belongs to the open backdrop-blur item (V8 in VISUAL-SPEC.md).
dock.item: Aether ships a deliberately tighter dock (46 px items, 38 px tiles, 7 px inner padding) than the demo's 48/39/7. Changing it moves every dock hit target and capture crop, so it belongs with the dock parity work rather than a token tweak.
dock.tile: See dock.item: the tile is 0.82x the 46 px item (37.7, rounded to 38) instead of 0.82x the demo's 48 px (39.36).
dock.pad: Aether paints 8 px of inner padding; the demo's 7 px plus a 1 px border gives 8 px outside. The visible inset is the same.
dock.height: Follows from dock.item (46 + 2 x 8 px padding) versus the demo's 48 + 2 x (7 + 1 border).
dock.width: Dock width is a consequence of the eight tiles at 46 px versus the demo's ten at 48 px (see structure.dock-items).
